artifacts.summary: Nine-phase, 10-hour plan landing the compiled finite-width refutation probe as PlusSlicedCertificate/Limits/NoFiniteWidth.lean, with the verbatim Deliverable 2 statements, the two scope limits in the docstrings, five docs/theorem-index.md rows carrying no pin claim, and the two in-library completeness restatements.

memory_candidates.content: Landing a compiled specs/<task>/probes/*.lean file into this repository's FormalSystem/ library is governed by a fixed, discoverable gate checklist that is NOT visible from the probe itself, and every item is mechanically forced: C9 bars task-number citations under FormalSystem/ (probe prose routinely cites 'task N' and must be re-anchored on a durable anchor); C15's second assertion requires each docs/theorem-index.md row's declaration to carry a doc comment immediately above it containing 'Paper: - (reason)'; C24 requires a transitive import of FormalSystem.Init; C30 bars blanket linter suppression, so a probe's file- or section-level 'set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false' cannot be transcribed, and scripts/warning-budget.txt lists that class as blocking with the prescribed per-declaration 'omit [...] in' fix; C33 requires regenerating FormalSystem.lean via 'lake exe mk_all --lib FormalSystem' (never by hand); readme-lint.sh check 1 is GATED and requires a README.md in every new directory containing .lean files; and the INV check requires 'check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory' because adding one .lean file moves three opt-in inventory blocks (root README.md totals, FormalSystem/README.md loose rows, FormalSystem/Metalogic/README.md subdir rows). A pinned:C2/pinned:C14 claim in a theorem-index row requires a baseline line inside check-module-invariants.sh, so a task that does not own that script must leave the Axioms cell unpinned rather than copy the neighbouring rows' token.
